name: Urban Ag Internships
what_you_do: You get a year-long paid internship at a school garden. It includes weekly garden hours, a workforce class, field trips to farms and guest speakers.
who_can_apply: Students at Luther Burbank High, Grant Union High and Sacramento Academic and Vocational Academy (SAVA).
pay_detail: Pay rate not posted on the page.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.
how_to_apply: The page does not explain how to apply. Ask a teacher or counselor at your host school, or contact the Center for Land-Based Learning: info@landbasedlearning.org or (530) 795-1520.
notes: Only at the three host schools. Grant Union students can earn college credit through a Sacramento State partnership (ACE program). Pay rate and hours per week are not posted. Paid job for a minor, so a work permit is likely needed.
